name: plan_j_all
label: The plan, every line J train to Nord-Est
about: Line J trains no longer end at the surface of Saint-Lazare: they use the underground platforms of RER F and run on to Nord-Est in 4 minutes, in the room RER F leaves in its tunnel (23 trains an hour for a limit of 32). Where they turn or run on beyond Nord-Est is left open (ASSUMPTION: they end at Nord-Est). All 25 trains of the busiest hour: more than the room left, a test of the upper bound.
